verses.en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Paulo, Silvano, e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses, em Deus Pai, e no Senhor Jesus Cristo; haja convosco a graça e a paz de Deus, nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

verses.en: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.pt: Sempre damos graças a Deus por todos vós, fazendo menção de vós em nossas orações.
verses.en_web: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
verses.en_bbe: We give praise to God at all times for you, keeping you in memory in our prayers;

verses.en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
verses.pt: E, diante do nosso Deus e Pai, nós nos lembramos sem cessar da obra da vossa fé, do trabalho do amor, e da firmeza da esperança no nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
verses.en_bbe: Having ever in mind your work of faith and acts of love and the strength of your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

verses.en: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
verses.pt: Sabemos, irmãos amados por Deus, que por ele fostes escolhidos,
verses.en_web: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
verses.en_bbe: Being conscious, my brothers, dear to God, that you have been marked out by God's purpose;

verses.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.pt: pois o nosso evangelho não foi até vós somente com palavras, mas também com poder, com o Espírito Santo, e com plena certeza; assim como sabeis de que maneira estivemos entre vós para o vosso benefício.
verses.en_web: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
verses.en_bbe: Because our good news came to you, not in word only, but in power, and in the Holy Spirit, so that you were completely certain of it; even as you saw what our behaviour to you was like from our love to you.

verses.en: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
verses.pt: E vos tornastes imitadores nossos e do Senhor. Mesmo em meio a muita aflição, recebestes a palavra com a alegria do Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.en_bbe: And you took us and the Lord as your example, after the word had come to you in much trouble, with joy in the Holy Spirit;

verses.en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.pt: Dessa maneira vos tornastes referências a todos os crentes na Macedônia e Acaia.
verses.en_web: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
verses.en_bbe: So that you became an example to all those who have faith in Christ in Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
verses.pt: Pois de vós ressoou a palavra do Senhor, não somente na Macedônia e Acaia, mas a vossa fé em Deus também se espalhou em todo lugar, de tal maneira que não precisamos falar coisa alguma.
verses.en_web: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.
verses.en_bbe: For not only was the word of the Lord sounding out from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith in God is made clear; so that we have no need to say anything.

verses.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
verses.pt: Pois eles mesmos anunciam como fomos recebidos por vós, e como vos convertestes, deixando os ídolos, para servir ao Deus vivo e verdadeiro;
verses.en_web: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you; and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
verses.en_bbe: For they themselves give the news of how we came among you; and how you were turned from images to God, to the worship of a true and living God,

verses.en: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
verses.pt: e para esperar dos céus o seu Filho, a quem ele ressuscitou dos mortos: Jesus, que nos livra da ira futura.
verses.en_web: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
verses.en_bbe: Waiting for his Son from heaven, who came back from the dead, even Jesus, our Saviour from the wrath to come.
